svg.title: Where new foam is born
svg.desc: One exaggerated wave and, under it, the four quantities FoamBlit computes along it: the grid determinant, the compression mask, the leading-edge mask and their product, which is non-zero just around and ahead of the crest.
svg.text: × scrolling noise (not shown). Graphs use rest
position x, which indexes the foam texture;
the profile on top is displaced.
